title: LinkedIn Jobs & Search URL Scraper Input Schema
description: Configure search parameters, filters, or direct LinkedIn search URLs to scrape job listings.

searchUrl.title: LinkedIn Search URL
searchUrl.description: Paste a direct LinkedIn job search URL (e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/search-results/?keywords=Schaeffler&f_TPR=r86400). If provided, keywords and filters will be automatically extracted.

includeKeyword.title: Keywords / Job Title
includeKeyword.description: Job title or skill keywords to search (e.g. software engineer, React, Data Scientist).

keywords.title: Batch Keywords List
keywords.description: List of keywords to search in batch (e.g. ['Frontend Developer', 'Backend Developer']).

locationName.title: Location Name
locationName.description: City, region, or country for job search (e.g., India, Bengaluru, Mumbai).

companyName.title: Company Name
companyName.description: Filter postings by hiring company name (e.g., Google, Tata, Infosys).

minSalary.title: Minimum Salary
minSalary.description: Filter listings with salary above this threshold.

maxSalary.title: Maximum Salary
maxSalary.description: Filter listings with salary below this threshold.

pagesToFetch.title: Pages to Fetch
pagesToFetch.description: Number of result pages to scrape per search.

maxResults.title: Maximum Total Results Cap
maxResults.description: Maximum total number of jobs to retrieve and save across all queries.

targetLocations.title: Target Locations List
targetLocations.description: Supplementary target locations to scrape in batch (e.g. ['Bengaluru', 'Delhi', 'Hyderabad']).

fetchFullDescription.title: Fetch Full Job Description
fetchFullDescription.description: Extract full HTML/markdown text of job descriptions.

forceFresh.title: Force Fresh Results
forceFresh.description: Bypass 24-hour cache and fetch fresh live results.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy settings for enterprise network routing.
